description: This file defines the ResourcePermission class, a data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM human resource management system to manage permissions (read, create, update, delete) for specific resources. It includes methods for combining permissions and initializing from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating permissions (read, create, update, delete) for a resource, with methods to combine permissions and create instances from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing permissions with boolean values for read, create, update, and delete.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission that is the logical AND of this permission and another.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission that is the logical OR of this permission and another.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission instance from an associative array of permissions, with an optional default value.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission instance from a DataGroupPermission object.
